descriptionChirho: Physical wing of a bird, cherub, seraph, or other winged creature, including attributive use (winged) and figurative use of God's protective wings.
Edge, corner, or extremity of a geographical area, the earth, or a structure such as an altar, translated in Arabic as arkaan/atraaf and in Swahili as pembe/ncha.
Edge, border, skirt, or hem of a garment, including the corner of a robe or cloak, translated in Arabic as taraf/dhayl and in Korean as jarak/otjarak.
